how_to_use.ask_how: Ask how to do something in METPAY or what an option means: it answers from the platform's manuals.
how_to_use.find_person: To look up a person, give the managing entity or collection operator and their name, document, email or username.

keep_in_mind.only_informs: It only informs: it does not make sales, top-ups or changes, nor check balances or reports.
keep_in_mind.no_secrets: It will never ask you for passwords, codes or PINs.
keep_in_mind.can_be_wrong: It can be wrong: confirm important data on the platform.
keep_in_mind.no_memory: It does not remember previous conversations when you start a new chat.
